doc_verification.detail: DELETE endpoint documented at https://api.qdrant.tech/api-reference/points/delete-points with two selection modes: 'points' (array of IDs) or 'filter' (Filter object). Docs state 'Must specify either points or filter parameter' but don't clarify exclusivity of compound filter with ids field. Contract qdrant_type_delete_points_001 asserts '(points IS NOT NULL AND len(points) > 0) OR (filter IS NOT NULL)'.

execution_evidence.log_pattern: [Compound AND] price 200-400 AND category B: HTTP Status: 400, Deleted: 0 points → [Compound OR] price=100 OR category A: HTTP Status: 400, Deleted: 50 points → response_excerpt: {'error': 'HTTP Error 400: Bad Request', 'body': '{"status":{"error":"Format error in JSON body: missing field `ids` at line 1 column 121"},"time":0.0}'}

http_semantics.note: Correctly returns HTTP 400 but error message 'missing field `ids`' is misleading when filter was provided. Response format: {"status":{"error":"Format error in JSON body: missing field `ids` at line 1 column 121"},"time":0.0}

contract_grounding.assertion_text_quoted: (points IS NOT NULL AND len(points) > 0) OR (filter IS NOT NULL)
contract_grounding.note: Request provides valid filter (not null, not empty), so constraint satisfied. Defect is error message misattribution, not constraint violation. API correctly rejects malformed request but diagnosis points to wrong field.

chain_links: log:HTTP 400 with 'missing field `ids`' despite filter being present
chain_trace.break_detail: Error message claims 'missing field ids' but request body actually contains filter. Either: (a) REST schema requires wrapper object with 'filter' key but script sent filter directly, or (b) deserialization expects 'ids' field as default name for point_ids array. Error diagnostic is factually incorrect.

source_grounding.source_excerpt: PointsSelector enum at lib/collection/src/operations/point_ops.rs:21-26 has two variants: PointIdsSelector(PointIdsList) and FilterSelector(Filter). REST API schema defines PointsSelector as request body for DELETE /collections/{name}/points. Error 'missing field `ids`' comes from serde deserialization failing to match either variant due to body structure mismatch. The 'ids' field name refers to internal PointIdsList field, not user-provided filter.
source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST POST /collections/{name}/points → actix update_api.rs:delete_points(Json<PointsSelector>) → serde deserializes request body into PointsSelector enum → fails to match PointIdsSelector (missing 'ids' field) or FilterSelector (expects 'filter' wrapper key) → returns 400 with serde's raw error message.

mundane_explanation.surviving: Type2_PoorDiagnostics confirmed across 3 collection sizes (50, 200, 500) with 2 compound filter types (AND, OR). All 6 test cases return HTTP 400 (correct) but with misleading error message 'missing field `ids`' when filter was actually provided. Error quality systematically poor: misattributes root cause, points to wrong field.
